actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Bite

actions.desc: The wolf stares down and growls at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. The wolf has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against the frightened creature.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Хунгрй Гровл»; тип: bonus_action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).

traits.desc: The wolf's Perception is 18 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
